rationale: This 1977 theoretical essay in organizational sociology examines resistance to authority within workplace bureaucracies using concepts from political opposition. It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation services, no water/sanitation access outcomes, and presents a theoretical framework rather than empirical water/sanitation evidence (primary exclusion code E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 because the paper is a general organizational sociology essay on workplace bureaucratic opposition and does not involve water or sanitation service access (E01).

evidence_quotes.quote: Bureaucratic Opposition: The Challenge to Authoritarian Abuses at the Workplace
ignored the phenomenon of resistance to authority within bureaucracies.
A framework for dealing with bureaucratic oppositions theoretically & empirically is provided
